sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:

Sounds easy, right? Well, it's not as simple as it sounds. With multiple enemies on screen at once, limited spray can capacity, and a ticking clock, The Fly demands quick reflexes and strategic thinking to succeed.

One of the key mechanics in The Fly is the spray can itself. Players must manage their spray can capacity carefully, as running out of spray will result in game over. To mitigate this, players can collect power-ups and upgrades that increase their spray can capacity or provide temporary shields. Additionally, players can use special abilities such as a powerful blast or a short-range shield to turn the tide of battle.

The Fly also features a variety of enemy types, each with its own unique behavior and attack patterns. Players must learn to recognize and counter these patterns to succeed. Overall, The Fly's core gameplay mechanics are simple yet challenging, making it an enjoyable experience for players of all skill levels. With its addictive gameplay and competitive high scores, The Fly is a must-play for fans of the genre.
